title: Ms.
text: We're so happy we chose this company for our balloon excursion.  It was a great experience for everyone.  I highly recommend this tour.
author: Cheryl S

title: Unmemorable
text:
Great experience for both the human quality of the pilot and the support staff. Very quiet, pleasant trip and spectacular views.
When choosing the exclusive flight I took the opportunity to ask my partner to marry me, in which all the members of the team turned to make this experience an unforgettable experience.
PS: My partner said yes!! :P
author: Eloi P

title: Great experience
text:
Not only the flight was a great experience but also the team that organized everything were very nice and fun too.

I would totally recoment it to anyone that is thinking of doing it. As a team we had a lot of fun.
